headline: Walk away mid-bomb — come back to your seat
lede: BOMB DEFUSE now re-seats a returning co-op partner IN FLIGHT: reopen the join URL while the run burns and the host hands your seat back mid-defuse — rebuilt at the host's tick, the CPU partner steps aside on the same tick on both boxes, and the hashes agree again before you notice.

notes.text: The honest end of the walkaway story: closing the tab demotes to the CPU partner as before, but the returner no longer waits for the next kickoff — rejoin, back, snapshot, mask backfill, flip. #1838 shipped the same session it was filed.

The shared flip is tied to the sim tick, never the wall clock — that is what keeps both boxes hashing identical through the hand-back. Patience counts STALL ticks: a window measured in sim-ticks could never expire while the host sits frozen at the ready gate (the trap this session found and pinned).

defuselinkcheck grew 48 to 73 gates with a second mutant (--mutate-reseat kills the flip red); defuselinkdrive reopens a third tab over a real relay and proves zero desyncs across the whole leave-and-return.
